# Security Policy

**PLEASE DO NOT DISCLOSE SECURITY-RELATED ISSUES PUBLICLY.**

## Supported Versions

Only the latest major version receives security fixes.

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Turbine, please send an email to Luan Freitas at [luanfreitas10@protonmail.com](mailto:luanfreitas10@protonmail.com).

All security vulnerabilities will be promptly acknowledged and addressed.
